t: This was the Chenil Gallery, a British art gallery in Chelsea that also served at times as a music studio. It operated between 1905 and 1927, and afterwards the building housed various businesses that nodded to that earlier artistic life. The gallery was founded by Jack Knewstub, born in 1872, so it began as his venture in the art world of Chelsea. There's little left of the gallery itself to point at, but the name and the idea of an art space here live on in the later uses of the site.
